title: Template:WorldEventTimetable/styles.css
text: /* Template:WorldEventTimetable/styles.css (set the content model to Sanitized CSS) The World Events timetable: daily events in seven day columns, game time events in their own panel. Dark colours are the default, the light theme overrides are at the bottom. Sanitized CSS has no CSS variables, so every colour is a literal value. */ .wev { margin: 0.8em 0 1.2em; color: #e8e1d6; font-size: 14px; } .wev-top { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px 14px; margin-bottom: 14px; } .wev-tz, .wev-gclock { display: inline-flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid #6a5340; border-radius: 18px; background: #241d18; font-size: 13px; } .wev-tz { margin-left: auto; } .wev-gclock { display: none; } .wev-js .wev-gclock:not(:empty) { display: inline-flex; } .wev-tzlabel, .wev-gclabel { color: #9a9082; } .wev-gcval { font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; letter-spacing: .04em; color: #e8e1d6; } .wev-tzname { font-weight: 700; color: #e8e1d6; } .wev-tzsel { padding: 1px 4px; border: 1px solid #6a5340; border-radius: 6px; background: #1a1715; color: #e8e1d6; font-size: 12px; } .wev-note { margin-top: 10px; color: #9a9082; font-size: 12px; } /* the seven days */ .wev-days { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(7, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 10px; align-items: start; } .wev-day { min-width: 0; } .wev-dayhead { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid #3a3430; border-radius: 8px; background: #241d18; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .1em; color: #c9bfb0; } .wev-today { display: none; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .06em; color: #e8e1d6; } .wev-day-today .wev-today { display: inline; } .wev-day-today .wev-dayhead { border-color: rgba(232, 225, 214, .5); background: rgba(232, 225, 214, .1); color: #ffffff; } .wev-events { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; margin-top: 10px; } /* one event: picture and time on the first line, the name under it */ .wev-ev { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 28px minmax(0, 1fr); grid-template-areas: "ico time" "text text"; align-items: center; gap: 4px 8px; padding: 7px 8px; border: 1px solid #3a3430; border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .035); } .wev-ev .wev-ico { grid-area: ico; } .wev-ev .wev-time { grid-area: time; justify-self: end; } .wev-ev .wev-text { grid-area: text; flex-direction: row; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0 6px; } .wev-ev .wev-name { flex: 1 1 auto; } .wev-ev .wev-sub { flex: none; font-size: 11px; } .wev-ev .wev-nexttag { flex: 0 0 100%; } .wev-time, .wev-chip { padding: 2px 9px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .03em; white-space: nowrap; } .wev-ico { position: relative; display: block; flex: none; width: 28px; height: 28px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 6px; background: #26211d; } .wev-ico span, .wev-ico a { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; } .wev-ico img { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; max-width: none; object-fit: cover; } .wev-text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; min-width: 0; } .wev-name { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25; color: #e8e1d6; } /* a name that links to its page keeps the white text */ .wev-name a, .wev-name a:visited, .wev-name a:hover, .wev-name a.new, .wev-name a.new:visited { color: inherit; } .wev-name a:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .wev-sub { font-size: 12px; color: #9a9082; } .wev-nexttag { display: none; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .1em; color: #f5cb65; } .wev-ev.wev-isnext { border-color: rgba(245, 203, 101, .7); background: rgba(245, 203, 101, .07); box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(245, 203, 101, .18); } .wev-isnext .wev-nexttag { display: block; } .wev-events:empty::after { content: "No events"; color: #6f6a5e; font-size: 12px; font-style: italic; text-align: center; } /* the game time events */ .wev-gt { margin-top: 22px; } .wev-gthead { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; gap: 4px 14px; margin-bottom: 10px; } .wev-gttitle { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #f5cb65; } .wev-gtnote { font-size: 12px; color: #9a9082; } .wev-gcards { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(250px, 1fr)); gap: 10px; } .wev-gc { padding: 10px; border: 1px solid #3a3430; border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .035); } .wev-gctop { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; } .wev-gctop .wev-ico { width: 36px; height: 36px; } .wev-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; margin-top: 10px; } .wev-chip { padding: 1px 7px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0; } .wev-chip-next { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(245, 203, 101, .9); } .wev-chipnone { font-size: 12px; color: #9a9082; } /* the Gold Trader card: up for a while, gone for a while, on repeat */ .wev-tr { margin-top: 22px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid #3a3430; border-radius: 8px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .035); } .wev-trtop { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 6px 10px; } .wev-trtop .wev-ico { width: 36px; height: 36px; } .wev-trstatus { margin-left: auto; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: #f5cb65; } .wev-trstatus:empty { display: none; } .wev-tr-active { border-color: rgba(123, 216, 143, .65); box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(123, 216, 143, .15); } .wev-tr-active .wev-trstatus { color: #7bd88f; } .wev-chip-active { box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #7bd88f; } /* chip colours */ .wev-c-mist .wev-time, .wev-c-mist .wev-chip { color: #ff9a6a; background: rgba(255, 138, 84, .15); border-color: rgba(255, 138, 84, .5); } .wev-c-halcy .wev-time, .wev-c-halcy .wev-chip { color: #5fe0c8; background: rgba(60, 210, 185, .15); border-color: rgba(60, 210, 185, .5); } .wev-c-luscas .wev-time, .wev-c-luscas .wev-chip { color: #c4a4ff; background: rgba(170, 130, 250, .15); border-color: rgba(170, 130, 250, .5); } .wev-c-gold .wev-time, .wev-c-gold .wev-chip { color: #f5cb65; background: rgba(245, 203, 101, .15); border-color: rgba(245, 203, 101, .5); } .wev-c-dgs .wev-time, .wev-c-dgs .wev-chip { color: #9fb4d6; background: rgba(140, 165, 205, .15); border-color: rgba(140, 165, 205, .5); } .wev-c-veroe .wev-time, .wev-c-veroe .wev-chip { color: #8fd36b; background: rgba(120, 200, 80, .15); border-color: rgba(120, 200, 80, .5); } .wev-c-abyss .wev-time, .wev-c-abyss .wev-chip { color: #6b9cff; background: rgba(90, 140, 255, .15); border-color: rgba(90, 140, 255, .5); } .wev-c-sushi .wev-time, .wev-c-sushi .wev-chip { color: #ff8fb8; background: rgba(255, 120, 170, .15); border-color: rgba(255, 120, 170, .5); /* Template:WorldEventTimetable/styles.css (set the content model to Sanitized CSS)
   The World Events timetable: daily events in seven day columns, game time events in their own panel.
   Dark colours are the default, the light theme overrides are at the bottom.
   Sanitized CSS has no CSS variables, so every colour is a literal value. */
.wev {
	margin: 0.8em 0 1.2em;
	color: #e8e1d6;
	font-size: 14px;
}
.wev-top {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: center;
	justify-content: space-between;
	gap: 10px 14px;
	margin-bottom: 14px;
}
.wev-tz, .wev-gclock {
	display: inline-flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	align-items: center;
	gap: 8px;
	padding: 6px 12px;
	border: 1px solid #6a5340;
	border-radius: 18px;
	background: #241d18;
	font-size: 13px;
}
.wev-tz { margin-left: auto; }
.wev-gclock { display: none; }
.wev-js .wev-gclock:not(:empty) { display: inline-flex; }
.wev-tzlabel, .wev-gclabel { color: #9a9082; }
.wev-gcval { font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; letter-spacing: .04em; color: #e8e1d6; }
.wev-tzname { font-weight: 700; color: #e8e1d6; }
.wev-tzsel {
	padding: 1px 4px;
	border: 1px solid #6a5340;
	border-radius: 6px;
	background: #1a1715;
	color: #e8e1d6;
	font-size: 12px;
}
.wev-note { margin-top: 10px; color: #9a9082; font-size: 12px; }
/* the seven days */
.wev-days {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: repeat(7, minmax(0, 1fr));
	gap: 10px;
	align-items: start;
}
.wev-day { min-width: 0; }
.wev-dayhead {
	display: flex;
	align-items: center;
	justify-content: space-between;
	padding: 8px 10px;
	border: 1px solid #3a3430;
	border-radius: 8px;
	background: #241d18;
	font-size: 13px;
	font-weight: 700;
	letter-spacing: .1em;
	color: #c9bfb0;
}
.wev-today { display: none; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .06em; color: #e8e1d6; }
.wev-day-today .wev-today { display: inline; }
.wev-day-today .wev-dayhead { border-color: rgba(232, 225, 214, .5); background: rgba(232, 225, 214, .1); color: #ffffff; }
.wev-events { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; margin-top: 10px; }
/* one event: picture and time on the first line, the name under it */
.wev-ev {
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: 28px minmax(0, 1fr);
	grid-template-areas: "ico time" "text text";
	align-items: center;
	gap: 4px 8px;
	padding: 7px 8px;
	border: 1px solid #3a3430;
	border-radius: 8px;
	background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .035);
}
.wev-ev .wev-ico { grid-area: ico; }

.wev-ev .wev-name { flex: 1 1 auto; }
.wev-ev .wev-sub { flex: none; font-size: 11px; }
.wev-ev .wev-nexttag { flex: 0 0 100%; }
.wev-time, .wev-chip {
	padding: 2px 9px;

	font-size: 15px;
	font-weight: 700;
	letter-spacing: .03em;

.wev-text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1px; min-width: 0; }
.wev-name { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25; color: #e8e1d6; }

/* the Gold Trader card: up for a while, gone for a while, on repeat */
